summary: Full validation of Sheet #13 (Admin Automation & Workflow Rules Engine) and Sheet #14 (Home Digital Twin / Lifetime Knowledge Log). Backend: 15/15 pytest pass in 2.23s (test_automation_home.py). Covered: GET /admin/automations/meta (returns >=4 triggers incl. signup/project_completed/subscription_started/referral_completed, >=5 actions, recipes), admin gating (403 for standard user on all /admin/automations endpoints), POST/GET/PATCH toggle/DELETE /admin/automations, POST /admin/automations/{id}/test (fires with sample data projects_completed=5, log persists in GET /admin/automations/logs), bad-trigger 400. Home: GET /api/home shape (rooms/systems/stats/years/log/room_types/system_types), admin has projects_completed>=1 with populated log, new user returns empty structure, POST/DELETE /home/rooms and /home/systems with GET verification, GET /home/year-review/{year} for admin's 2026 year returns projects>=1 with money_saved_cents/invested_cents/hours/top_skills/highlights, year with no data returns projects=0 cleanly, auth required (401/403). No MongoDB _id leakage in responses. Frontend (Expo web): Admin flow (desktop 1280x900) — logged in as Diyhomieapp@gmail.com → /admin → admin-nav-automations opens Automations page with 'When ___ happens, do ___.' subhead. Rules/Activity tabs both visible (auto-tab-rules, auto-tab-activity). Tapped auto-new → builder opens → filled auto-name='TEST_UI Reward 5th' → picked auto-trigger-project_completed → tapped auto-addcond-projects_completed (default op=gte value=1) → tapped auto-addaction-award_credits → auto-save persisted rule; rule card appeared with auto-toggle-{id} Switch, auto-test-{id} and auto-delete-{id} buttons. Test button fired the rule and inserted a log entry visible in Activity tab (✓ TEST_UI Reward 5th (test) · project_completed · diyhomieapp@gmail.com · +0 credits). Recipe auto-recipe-0 clone pre-filled builder name '5th project → bonus credits + badge email'. auto-delete-{id} removed rule from list. User flow (mobile 390x844) — logged in as admin (has 1 completed project) → /profile → profile-home menu row visible and navigates to /home-profile. Hero card 'Your home's living record' + stat grid (PROJECTS=1, SAVED=$115, INVESTED=$35, YEARS=1) all render. home-add-room modal → home-add-name + Kitchen chip + home-add-submit → 'TEST_UI Kitchen' listed with home-del-room-{id}. home-add-system modal → name + HVAC chip + home-add-year=2020 + home-add-submit → 'TEST_UI HVAC · HVAC · 2020' listed with home-del-system-{id}. home-year-2026 chip opens Year-in-Review modal with year, 1 PROJECTS, $115 SAVED, 2 HOURS, 'Top skills: Bathroom Pro' and NICE! close button. LIFETIME KNOWLEDGE LOG shows 'Jul 4, 2026 · bathroom / Leaky Faucet Fixed! / Fix a leaky bathroom faucet / Saved $115'. Delete room + system both worked. Regression: admin-nav-proleads renders Pro Leads, admin-nav-finance renders CFO Dashboard, /search still renders search input. No red-screen or crash. Some cosmetic React warnings only (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver — pre-existing, not from this iteration).

issues: Minor UX: adding an 'award_credits' action does not require an amount — leaving the amount TextInput empty saves the rule and Test-runs it with '+0 credits' in the log (see attached admin_auto.png). Consider blocking Save when award_credits.amount is empty/<=0, or defaulting to 10. Not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Add front-end guard in AutomationModule.save(): require award_credits actions to have amount>0 before allowing SAVE — otherwise Test emits '+0 credits' log which is confusing.

(Optional / pre-existing, not blocking) Metro version drift warning: expo@54.0.34 vs expected ~54.0.35 (and expo-font/expo-router minors). No functional impact but easy `yarn add expo@~54.0.35 expo-font@~14.0.12 expo-router@~6.0.24`.

(Optional / pre-existing) React Native web console warnings: shadow* style props, props.pointerEvents, and useNativeDriver JS fallback — cosmetic warnings from RN-web, unchanged from prior iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1500 _cond_ok safely handles op ∈ {gte,lte,eq,contains} with try/except on TypeError/ValueError — never raises.
server.py:1518 _run_action wraps each action in try/except so a single bad action doesn't crash the rule, and returns structured {type,ok,detail}.

server.py:1545 emit_event handles both live-fire (find enabled rules for trigger) and test-fire (pass a single rule directly) via `test_rule` param — clean design; increments runs counter only on live fires.
server.py:1588 create_automation validates trigger against AUTOMATION_TRIGGERS enum → 400 on unknown (test_bad_trigger_400 passes).
server.py:1631 test_automation uses a fixed sample payload with projects_completed=5, money_saved_cents=120000 etc — matches all 4 recipe condition thresholds so Test-run reliably fires. Good design.
server.py:1646 _home_profile idempotent — creates empty {rooms:[], systems:[]} on first access; setdefault covers legacy docs without those arrays.
server.py:1663 get_home aggregates timeline + home_memory into a unified log[], sorted desc by created_at, capped to 200. Uses (_id:0) projection everywhere → no ObjectId leakage.
server.py:1712-1747 room/system add/delete use $push and $pull with per-item id → no risk of collision; string fields sliced to safe caps (60/300).
server.py:1751 year_review filters timeline by _year() (which safely returns None for bad ISO), aggregates skills with top-3, and returns highlights[]. Consistent shape.
AutomationModule.tsx:53 save() blocks with Alert if !name or actions empty — good client guard. However does NOT require action params (e.g. amount for award_credits) — see design_issues.
AutomationModule.tsx:65 test() shows Alert with fired/not-fired verdict then switches to Activity tab and reloads logs — nice UX chain.
AutomationModule.tsx:61,69 toggle() and remove() do optimistic UI updates with load() rollback on error — resilient.
home-profile.tsx:39 useFocusEffect(load) refreshes on nav-back — ensures newly-completed projects appear in log immediately.
home-profile.tsx:62 del() also does optimistic UI update with load() rollback.
home-profile.tsx:171-192 add-modal wrapped in KeyboardAvoidingView (iOS) with proper testIDs (home-add-name/type-chips/home-add-year/home-add-notes/home-add-submit) — mobile-first correct.

All new components use React Native primitives (View/Text/Pressable/Modal/ScrollView/TextInput/Switch/KeyboardAvoidingView) + StyleSheet.create + MaterialCommunityIcons only — no HTML tags, no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch.
